source.title: 2026 NCAA Football Rules Book
source.note: Rule numbers and pages from the rules book's Appendix G, Summary of Penalties, and the article headings (PDF pages, the file's own numbering). Explanations are ours, in plain words.

penalties.name: False start
penalties.what: An offensive player moved before the snap in a way that looks like the play is starting: a lineman jumping, or anyone faking the snap count.

penalties.name: Offside
penalties.what: A defender was across the line of scrimmage, or touched an offensive player, when the ball was snapped. If the offense moved first, the flag is a false start instead.

penalties.name: Delay of game
penalties.what: The offense didn't snap the ball before the play clock (40 or 25 seconds) ran out, or a team held up the game some other way.

penalties.name: Illegal formation
penalties.what: The offense lined up wrong at the snap: fewer than seven players on the line, or a player not clearly on the line or in the backfield.

penalties.name: Illegal motion
penalties.what: One offensive player may be moving at the snap, but only sideways or backward. Moving toward the line, or two players moving, is a foul.

penalties.name: Illegal shift
penalties.what: After players changed position before the snap, the offense didn't hold still for a full second before the ball was snapped.

penalties.name: Illegal snap
penalties.what: The snap wasn't made correctly: the center lifted, moved or faked the ball before snapping it.

penalties.name: Illegal substitution
penalties.what: A substitution broke the rules: a player entered or left at the wrong time, or the offense subbed in a way that kept the defense from matching up.

penalties.name: Too many players
penalties.what: A team had twelve or more players in the formation or in the play.

penalties.name: Holding
penalties.what: A player grabbed or hooked an opponent to stop him, instead of blocking him with hands and body. Most often a lineman pulling a pass rusher down.

calls.result: 10 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Illegal use of hands
penalties.what: A player shoved or struck an opponent with his hands in a way the rules don't allow, often hands to the face or helmet.

calls.result: 10 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Illegal block in the back
penalties.what: A player blocked an opponent from behind, above the waist. Common on punt and kick returns.

penalties.name: Pass interference
penalties.what: While a catchable pass was in the air, a player blocked, pushed or grabbed an opponent to keep him from catching it.

calls.result: Ball at the spot of the foul if that's under 15 yards, else 15 yards; an automatic first down

penalties.name: Ineligible receiver downfield
penalties.what: An offensive lineman was more than three yards past the line before a forward pass was thrown across it.

penalties.name: Illegal forward pass
penalties.what: A forward pass broke the rules: thrown from past the line of scrimmage, or a second forward pass on the same play.

calls.result: 5 yards and a loss of down

penalties.name: Intentional grounding
penalties.what: The passer threw the ball away to avoid a sack without a receiver nearby, while still inside the tackles or without reaching the line of scrimmage.

calls.result: Loss of down at the spot of the foul

penalties.name: Illegal touching of a pass
penalties.what: A player who wasn't allowed to catch a pass touched it first: an ineligible lineman, or a receiver who'd gone out of bounds and came back.

calls.result: 5 yards and a loss of down

penalties.name: Personal foul
penalties.what: The general name for a dangerous hit: a late hit, a hit on a player out of the play, a blow to the head. The play-by-play often names only the category.

calls.result: 15 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Unnecessary roughness
penalties.what: A hit the play didn't call for: after the whistle, on a player out of bounds, or on someone clearly out of the play.

calls.result: 15 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Late hit
penalties.what: A player was hit after the play was over or after he'd gone out of bounds.

calls.result: 15 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Face mask
penalties.what: A player grabbed and twisted, turned or pulled an opponent's face mask or helmet opening.

calls.result: 15 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Targeting
penalties.what: A player hit an opponent with the crown of his helmet, or hit a defenseless player in the head or neck. The replay booth reviews every call. The player is disqualified, and for a foul in the second half he also misses the first half of the next game.

calls.result: 15 yards, an automatic first down, and the player is disqualified
15 yards, an automatic first down, and the player is disqualified

penalties.name: Roughing the passer
penalties.what: A defender hit the quarterback after the ball was clearly gone, or hit him low, or in the head.

calls.result: 15 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Roughing the kicker
penalties.what: A defender who didn't touch the kick slammed into the punter, kicker or holder. Worse than running into him: the hit could hurt him.

calls.result: 15 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Running into the kicker
penalties.what: A defender bumped the kicker or holder after the kick without touching the ball. Lighter contact than roughing the kicker.

penalties.name: Kick catch interference
aliases: interference with opportunity to catch a kick
penalties.what: A player on the kicking team got in the way of the returner while he was trying to catch a punt or kickoff.

penalties.name: Horse-collar tackle
penalties.what: A tackler grabbed the inside back or side of the runner's collar or shoulder pads and pulled him down.

calls.result: 15 yards and an automatic first down

penalties.name: Block below the waist
penalties.what: A block on an opponent's legs where the rules don't allow it, such as from the side or behind, or away from the line.

penalties.name: Chop block
penalties.what: Two blockers took on one defender at once, one high and one at the knees. It's banned because it wrecks knees.

penalties.name: Clipping
penalties.what: A block from behind at or below the waist.

penalties.name: Illegal blind-side block
penalties.what: A player threw a hard block with forcible contact on an opponent who didn't see it coming, moving toward his own end line.

penalties.name: Tripping
penalties.what: A player tripped an opponent with his leg or foot, or struck him with a fist, forearm or knee.

penalties.name: Leaping or hurdling
penalties.what: On a kick, a defender ran and jumped over the line to block it, or used a teammate to climb. On any play, a player hurdled an opponent who was still on his feet.

penalties.name: Unsportsmanlike conduct
penalties.what: Behavior the rules ban outside of contact: taunting, baiting an opponent, a celebration aimed at someone. Two in one game and the player is ejected.

penalties.name: Sideline interference
penalties.what: Coaches or players were out of the team area along the sideline and got in the officials' way. The first time is a warning.

calls.result: A warning, then 5 yards, then 15 yards

penalties.name: Fighting
penalties.what: A player threw a punch or tried to fight an opponent.

calls.result: 15 yards and the player is ejected
